resources.string: Google TV can\'t approve HearthTube for kids. This lets it open anyway; Hearth\'s bedtime and screen time still apply.
Lets HearthTube open in Google TV kids profiles. It asks for no device controls: it can\'t lock, wipe or change anything. Turn it off in HearthTube\'s settings.
This TV can\'t switch this on
Needs the latest Hearth as the TV\'s home screen, so bedtime and screen time still apply
